title: Just the 'Facts, Part 4
description: Just the 'Facts, Part 4 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Jerome's Bones

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go to Level 4 of the Shadow's Embrace. Kill Oroks until you obtain an Artifact Chest Skeleton Key, then unlock a nearby artifact chest. Bring the first artifact you find back to Jerome's bones in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Jerome's Bones

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Just the 'Facts, Only Moreso

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go to Level 4 of the Shadow's Embrace. Kill Oroks until you obtain an Artifact Chest Skeleton Key, then unlock a nearby artifact chest. Bring the first artifact you find back to Jerome's bones in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

I swear t' Gosh this is gettin' monotonous. But, I got a new plan. This one's *gotta* work! Go to Level 4 of the Shadow's Embrace and kill Oroks 'til ya get an Artifact Chest Skeleton Key. Then, come back here t' me with the first artifact ya find.

Here's my thinkin': If the artifacts on Level 1 are kinda mystical, and the ones on Level 2 are *more* mystical, and the ones on Level 3 are *even more* mystical, then the ones on Level 4 have to be squirting mysticality out every orifice!

Turn-in:

This next artifact may be my last chance chance t' resurrect. Cross yer fingers!

....

Well, looks like that one didn't work, either. I'd sigh in despair, but I think I need lungs t' make that happen.

Objectives:

  • Retrieve Mystical Artifact ×1

Level range: 47–100
